177:     def hash_asset(self, path, asset, synthetic, started):
178:         self.admission_reads += 1

192:                      "RUNTIME_FACTORY", "ACQUISITION_SERVICE"))):

194:         self.stack = ExitStack()
195:         replacements = (

198:             (adapter, "RUNTIME_PROFILE", self.profile),

201:             (resolver, "_checked_chain", self.observed),

209:             (self.kernel, "close_and_join", self.close_and_join),

212:             for owner, name, value in replacements:

216:             raise
